# Stellar AppKit

> One SDK for every Stellar wallet — unified wallet API, Soroban built in, real transaction previews, and framework wrappers for React, Vue, Solid, and Svelte.

Stellar AppKit is a Web3Modal / Reown AppKit equivalent for Stellar. It provides one unified wallet API, a first-class Soroban layer, real transaction previews instead of raw XDR, and a themeable UI that works identically dropped into any site.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/getting-started/introduction/): Overview, features, and why Stellar AppKit exists
- [Installation](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/getting-started/installation/): Install the core package, wallet SDKs, and framework wrappers
- [Quick Start](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/getting-started/quick-start/): Working wallet connect flow in 10 lines
- [Wallet Connection](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/core/wallet-connection/): Connect wallets, manage sessions, switch accounts, network mismatch recovery
- [Transaction Preview](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/core/transaction-preview/): Risk flags, contract badges, fee estimates, balance deltas
- [Soroban Integration](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/core/soroban/): invoke(), RPC failover, typed contract clients, auth-entry signing
- [Sign-In With Stellar](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/core/siws/): SEP-0053 signing, multi-candidate verification, debug diagnostics
- [Theming](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/core/theming/): CSS custom properties, theme attribute, all modal attributes

## Framework Wrappers

- [React](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wrappers/react/): useSyncExternalStore-based hooks, tearing-safe
- [Vue](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wrappers/vue/): Composition API composables
- [Solid](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wrappers/solid/): createSignal/createMemo hooks
- [Svelte](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wrappers/svelte/): Svelte 4 + 5 compatible stores
- [Modal Components](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wrappers/modal-components/): Typed <StellarAppKitModal> component for React/Vue/Solid + use:stellarmodal Svelte action

## Soroban Features

- [Typed Contract Client](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/soroban/typed-client/): Type-safe contract calls from TS interface
- [RPC Failover](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/soroban/rpc-failover/): Multi-provider failover with health tracking
- [Contract Badges](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/soroban/badges/): Verified, audited, published-by badges
- [Fee Estimation](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/soroban/fee-estimation/): Full fee breakdown before signing
- [Auth-Entry Signing](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/soroban/auth-entry/): Soroban delegated auth via authorizeEntry()

## Wallets

- [Freighter](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wallets/freighter/): Extension + mobile, SEP-0053 signing
- [Albedo](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wallets/albedo/): Popup-based, no install required
- [xBull](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wallets/xbull/): Extension detection polling, best-effort SIWS
- [Ledger](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wallets/ledger/): WebHID/WebUSB, multi-account, auth-entry signing
- [WalletConnect](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wallets/walletconnect/): QR pairing, mobile deep-linking — covers Hana, Lobstr, Hot Wallet
- [Hana Wallet](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/wallets/hana/): SDF's wallet, connects via WalletConnect

## UI Components

- [Modal](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/ui/modal/): Shadow DOM Web Component, attributes, events, WAAPI animations, default connectors, Installed badge
- [Bottom Sheet](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/ui/bottomsheet/): Draggable with custom spring physics (zero dependencies)
- [Avatars](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/ui/avatars/): Wallet-provided, Stellar Expert, gradient fallback
- [Copy-to-Clipboard](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/ui/copy-clipboard/): Per-address feedback

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/reference/api/): StellarAppKit, SorobanConnection, verifySiws
- [Error Handling](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/reference/errors/): ConnectError, NetworkMismatchError, SEP-43 codes
- [Bundle Size](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/reference/bundle-size/): Tree-shaking guarantees
- [AI Integration](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/reference/ai-integration/): SKILL.md and llms.txt — let AI agents (Cursor, Copilot, Claude) write correct Stellar AppKit code
- [Changelog](https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/reference/changelog/): Release history

## AI-Readable Files

The library repo also ships two AI-readable files at its root, so AI coding tools can pick up the full API surface without you having to paste docs into chat:

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/sagantaHQ/stellar-appkit/blob/main/SKILL.md): Structured AI skill file with trigger conditions, install commands, common code patterns, and API tables. Used by skill-aware agents (Claude Code with skills, custom agents).
- [llms.txt](https://github.com/sagantaHQ/stellar-appkit/blob/main/llms.txt): Compact plain-text API index following the llms.txt convention. Read by any agent that reads repo files (Cursor, Continue, Copilot).

This docs site also serves its own compact index (`https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/llms.txt`) and full-content dump (`https://stellar-appkit.saganta.com/llms-full.txt`) for one-fetch context loading.
